title: Inspect and export discovered companies and jobs
summary: Read retained companies, jobs, collection outcomes and coverage, or export one consistent JSON snapshot for downstream selection without starting collection.
use_when: A caller needs retained employer/posting evidence or collection freshness and limitations.
A downstream product needs a consistent machine-readable discovery snapshot.
do_not_use_when: Current remote sources must be fetched or a discovery run started.
Stored observations should be treated as a personal recommendation, application state or guaranteed current availability.
outcome: Retained discovery records or one consistent JSON snapshot carrying stable identities, revisions, evidence and collection coverage.
effects: Reads retained Cast state without fetching external sources or running a model. Output may disclose private query interests, posting text and source locators.
An explicit export --output writes and atomically replaces a private caller-selected file; stdout reads do not write an export.
authority: Cast owns retained identities, revisions, evidence and read projections. External sources remain authoritative for their underlying facts.
Consumers own filtering, consumed revisions, packet state and notification history.
success: The requested read completes against supported initialized state. Export returns a consistent snapshot with its schema version, revision, capture time, companies, jobs, source health and query coverage.
failure_and_recovery: Missing records or empty results describe only the selected retained state. Inspect source coverage before interpreting absence.
Use supported configuration/collection commands to refresh information and state reconcile-ownership for the documented ownership correction; do not inspect or repair SQLite directly.
privacy: CLI output and exported snapshots are private caller-owned data. Reads send no information to remote systems.
does_not_authorize: Selecting jobs for the user, creating CRM cases or application packets, sending email, submitting applications, invoking an agent or browser, or enabling a schedule.
Refreshing external sources or treating stored evidence as fresh external truth.

consumers.statement: Local callers and downstream products can inspect retained discovery evidence and consume consistent exports.

preconditions.statement: The selected state directory contains a supported initialized Cast database and the requested identity or command is valid.

inputs.statement: Inputs are one selected state directory, a supported read command and optional record identity.

outputs.statement: Export schema 1 returns snapshot_revision, captured_at, companies, jobs, source_health and coverage. Individual records preserve stable IDs and attributed evidence.

data_semantics.statement: Revisions track retained record changes; observation dates, source-provided dates, job availability and collection health remain separate. Stored relevance reasons describe discovery signals rather than personal recommendations.

Description excerpts are capped at 1,200 characters. Third-party discovery has unknown availability until employer/ATS observation. Authoritative absence records missing; presumed_closed requires at least two complete missing scans and 24 hours since the first absence. Neither constitutes an employer hiring outcome.

identity_and_units.statement: Company, job and source IDs are opaque Cast identities; a snapshot revision identifies retained state at export. ATS sources use canonical provider/tenant owners independently of linking website candidates. Ownership correction can change job company_id and revision while preserving job/source IDs; equal company names alone do not establish a merge.
Reads define no billing, relevance-probability or confidence unit.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Export is consistent for the selected retained state. Source coverage and successful observation times bound any conclusion about completeness or freshness.
Reads do not refresh sources, guarantee job-market coverage or verify real-world truth.

access.statement: Supported consumers use the local CLI or exported Cast Rust API; direct SQLite is not a consumer boundary.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: A snapshot reads within one database transaction and starts no collection work. Separate reads need not share a snapshot.

operational_limits.statement: The export returns retained current records rather than a durable event stream or consumer acknowledgement protocol.
No maximum database size, export size or read-latency service level is promised.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Capability version 1 and export schema 1 are independent of the Cast package version.
No future deprecation window is promised.

reliances.statement: Reads use only Cast retained local state. Source locators are stored evidence and cause no remote call.
